title: AI generated mobile game Pinball Soccer
author: Ai_Test_4704
selftext:
I use AI at work, and because AI agents will replace us all soon (hope not) I decided to sharpen my AI skills though building something fun.

My first try failed miserably, I could not bring chatGPT to create a decent animation and embed it in a godot game.

So I searched for something easier... no animations :).

I have seen here or somewhere on reddit a post where a guy was making a soccer pinball game... so I thought: I can try this. Stole the idea (sorry), inverted the title and here is the result.

If anyone is interested.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pinballsoccer.game
